offsetOwnership: whole-source groups + one active component study -> complete world intentions -> actual immediate-parent residual translations; local restoration retains whole expansion; final whole restoration zeros every leaf

workingMotion.sourceKind: STEP source identities with authored teaching kinematics
workingMotion.anglePolicy: One illustrative input turn: angle=2*pi*motionDemoProgress; progress 0 and 1 return exact identity. The timeline owns easing and timing.
workingMotion.axisPolicy: Original motor-shaft rest origin and its source local +Y axis, mapped into display world metres; this is an authored input-axis choice, not a recovered revolute mate.
workingMotion.membershipPolicy: Rotor/body/magnet/shaft/nut co-rotation is an explicit mechanical interpretation of source names and coaxial geometry; the original STEP supplies no rigid mates. The source manual confirms sun-to-motor attachment and encoder-holder-to-rear-nut attachment.
workingMotion.fixedPolicy: Stator, mount and forty generic cc pieces hold their source placement; cc is not assigned a winding function. Ring/planet/bearing output motion is not inferred.
limitations: No gear contact, signed reduction, tooth counts, torque, speed or load model.
No dynamics, electromagnetic or collision validation.
Display translations remain separate; rotating labels must be suppressed.
workingMotion.runtimeOwner: kinematics.workingPoses -> viewer.model; source static rest remains the immutable baseline

presentation.envelopeMethod: Immutable native source AABBs + whole/local/focus endpoints + analytic rigid-rotation source envelope. Component cameras operate in the persistent expanded whole frame; context may leave a macro frame.
presentation.opacity: Whole context fades before input close-up; inner context retains the component-study ghost policy; contexts recover during wide hand-offs.
presentation.macroType: Original occurrence tracking first, camera magnification second; fixed reduced-motion macro during settled read.

limitations: Whole/component explosion and focus excursions are editorial, not service or collision-checked disassembly.
Input co-rotation is an authored teaching linkage supported by selected manual attachments and source geometry; the STEP provides no recovered mates.
Planet/ring/bearing transmission, 34:1 signed kinematics, torque, load and dynamics are not simulated.
Generic cc and Part N names retain their source uncertainty.
